summary: Report imports crossing top-level domain boundaries, from the resolved symbol graph (relative imports anchored to their real package). Policy comes from the project; without one, crossings are neutral facts.

allowed_edges.description: optional allowed domain edges, formatted from->to

policy.description: layering policy {layers:{domain:layer}, allowed_edges:["A->B"]}; absent -> no verdict, crossings are neutral facts. Also auto-read from <project_root>/.uh-policy.json
